originalTitle: How Risky Is Home Depot Stock?
summary: Home Depot (HD) stock has fallen 12.6% in a month, with no company news to explain it, while the S&P 500 slipped 0.3%. content:
Home Depot (HD) stock has fallen 12.6% in a month , with no company news to explain it, while the S&P 500 slipped 0.3%. The loss came while the market was flat, so a market fall could further worsen the situation. Holders who stay are counting on the stock to recover as it did after past shocks. Holders are also counting on a business as profitable as it was then. So how risky is Home Depot stock if the market turns down?

Home Depot Keeps Less Of Each Sales Dollar

Home Depot is a less profitable business than it was three years ago. Operating margin, the share of sales left as profit after operating costs, was 14.9% three years ago. It is 12.4% over the last twelve months. The margin fell each year in between.

Home Depot’s sales and debt are not the problem. Revenue was $169.2 billion over the last twelve months, up from $165.1 billion a year earlier. Debt is 22.3% of the company’s market value, close to the 21% for the S&P 500.

Home Depot is exposed to housing. Management said on the August 18, 2026 earnings call that housing turnover has been at historical lows for four years. Housing turnover is the pace at which homes change hands. Management also said larger discretionary projects remain under pressure.

Management forecasts an operating margin of 12.4% to 12.6% for fiscal 2026. Meeting that forecast would hold the margin at or just above the 12.4% of the last twelve months. That level is a five-year low. Home Depot was more profitable in the market shocks of the past five years than it is today.

Has Home Depot Dropped More Than The Market Before?

Home Depot stock has dropped slightly more than the market, on average. The company has traded through fifteen market shocks since 2007 , as tracked by Trefis. Home Depot’s average fall in those shocks was 16.9%, against 15.8% for the S&P 500.

The deepest of the fifteen came in the pandemic shock of 2020. Home Depot fell 37% from peak to low, against 34% for the index.

The stock fell in fourteen of the fifteen shocks and regained its pre-shock high every time. The median recovery was 2.9 months from the low. Half were slower. Two of the fourteen recoveries took more than a year, so a repeat can cost time as well as money.

What Would You Lose In Another 37% Drop?

A repeat of the 2020 fall would cost 3.7% of your portfolio if Home Depot is a tenth of it. That loss is from Home Depot alone, with everything else held flat.

One of the two slow recoveries came after the interest-rate shock of 2022. Home Depot fell 34% in that shock, against 24% for the S&P 500. The stock then needed 17.8 months from its low to regain its pre-shock high.

Home Depot’s average fall in shocks is close to the market’s, but its operating margin has shrunk for three years. The fiscal 2026 operating margin is due with Home Depot’s full-year results. A margin below 12.4% would mean Home Depot is still getting less profitable. Home Depot’s recent recoveries would then be a weaker guide, because they came from a more profitable company.

Does This Mean You Should Act On HD?

Our purpose is to inform you with unique data so you make the right investment decisions. That said, betting on a single stock is always risky, no matter which direction you choose.

There is a smarter approach. Since its inception, the Trefis High Quality (HQ) Portfolio has returned 105%, beating the benchmark that combines the three major indices – the S&P 500, S&P Mid-cap, and Russell 2000. And it did so without taking the concentrated risk that comes with do-it-yourself stock picking. If that is how you want to invest, the HQ Portfolio is the place to start.
chineseTitle: 家得宝股票的风险有多大？
chineseSummary: 家得宝 (HD) 股价一个月内下跌 12.6%，没有任何公司新闻可以解释这一点，而标准普尔 500 指数则下跌 0.3%。损失发生时市场表现平淡，因此市场下跌可能会使情况进一步恶化。留下来的持有者指望该股能像过去的震荡后那样反弹。持有人还指望该业务能像当时一样盈利。那么，如果市场下跌，家得宝股票的风险有多大。
chineseContent:
家得宝 (HD) 股价在一个月内下跌了 12.6%，没有任何公司新闻可以解释这一点，而标准普尔 500 指数则下跌 0.3%。损失发生时市场表现平淡，因此市场下跌可能会使情况进一步恶化。留下来的持有者指望该股能像过去的震荡后那样反弹。持有人还指望该业务能像当时一样盈利。那么，如果市场下跌，家得宝股票的风险有多大？

家得宝 (Home Depot) 保留的每一美元销售额都减少了

与三年前相比，家得宝的盈利能力有所下降。营业利润率，即扣除营业成本后剩余的销售额份额，三年前为 14.9%。过去 12 个月为 12.4%。其间利润率逐年下降。

家得宝的销售额和债务不是问题。过去 12 个月的收入为 1,692 亿美元，高于去年同期的 1,651 亿美元。债务占公司市值的 22.3%，接近标准普尔 500 指数的 21%。

家得宝 (Home Depot) 暴露于住房。管理层在 2026 年 8 月 18 日的财报电话会议上表示，房屋成交量已处于四年来的历史低点。房屋周转率是指房屋易手的速度。管理层还表示，较大的可自由支配项目仍然面临压力。

管理层预测 2026 财年的营业利润率为 12.4% 至 12.6%。如果达到这一预测，利润率将保持在或略高于过去 12 个月的 12.4%。该水平是五年来的最低水平。家得宝在过去五年的市场冲击中比现在的利润更高。

家得宝（Home Depot）之前跌幅是否超过市场？

家得宝股票的平均跌幅略高于市场。据 Trefis 追踪，自 2007 年以来，该公司已经经历了 15 次市场冲击。家得宝在这些冲击中的平均跌幅为 16.9%，而标准普尔 500 指数平均跌幅为 15.8%。

其中最严重的是 2020 年的大流行冲击。家得宝 (Home Depot) 从峰值到低点下跌了 37%，而该指数下跌了 34%。

该股在 15 次震荡中，有 14 次下跌，但每次都恢复到震荡前的高点。中位复苏时间为距最低点 2.9 个月。一半的速度较慢。十四次康复中有两次需要一年多的时间，因此重复进行可能会花费时间和金钱。

如果再下跌 37%，您会损失什么？

如果家得宝 (Home Depot) 只占投资组合的十分之一，那么 2020 年的下跌重演将导致您的投资组合损失 3.7%。这一损失仅来自家得宝，其他一切均持平。

两次缓慢复苏之一是在 2022 年利率冲击之后。家得宝在那次冲击中下跌了 34%，而标准普尔 500 指数下跌了 24%。该股随后需要 17.8 个月的时间才能从低点恢复到冲击前的高点。

家得宝的平均震荡跌幅接近市场，但其营业利润率已连续三年缩水。 2026 财年营业利润率取决于家得宝的全年业绩。低于 12.4% 的利润率意味着家得宝的利润仍然较低。家得宝最近的复苏将是一个较弱的指导，因为它们来自一家盈利能力更强的公司。

这是否意味着您应该采取 HD 行动？

我们的目的是为您提供独特的数据，以便您做出正确的投资决策。也就是说，无论您选择哪个方向，押注单一股票总是有风险的。

有一个更聪明的方法。自成立以来，Trefis High Quality (HQ) 投资组合的回报率为 105%，超过了结合三大指数（S&P 500、S&P Mid-cap 和 Russell 2000）的基准。而且它没有承担自行选股带来的集中风险。如果这就是您想要的投资方式，那么总部投资组合就是您的起点。
